# 获取人脸配置信息_copy
##### 简要描述

- #### 以T5AI设备为例说明

**xml**

``` xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<FaceConfig>
    <SnapshotMode><--xs:string,”auto,fast,optimal,custom,pass” --></SnapshotMode>
    <CutoutMode><--xs:string,”face_only,half_body,whole_body” --></CutoutMode>
    <SaveSnapImage><--xs:boolean--></SaveSnapImage>
    <ModeAuto>
        <SnapshotCount><--xs:interger,1~3--></SnapshotCount>
        <MaxSnapshotCount><--xs:interger--></MaxSnapshotCount>
        <SnapshotInterval><--xs:interger,the unit is ms--></SnapshotInterval>
        <Sensitivity><--xs:interger--></Sensitivity>
    </ModeAuto>
    <ModeFast>
        <SnapshotCount><--xs:interger,1~3--></SnapshotCount>
        <MaxSnapshotCount><--xs:interger,1~3--></MaxSnapshotCount>
        <HighQuality><--xs:boolean--></HighQuality>
        <SnapShotInterval><--xs:interger,the unit is ms--></SnapShotInterval>
        <Sensitivity><--xs:interger--></Sensitivity>
    </ModeFast>
    <ModeOptimal>
        <SnapshotCount><--xs:interger,1~3--></SnapshotCount>
        <MaxSnapshotCount><--xs:interger,1~3--></MaxSnapshotCount>
        <SnapshotInterval><--xs:interger,the unit is ms--></SnapshotInterval>
        <SnapshotDelay><--xs:interger,the unit is ms--></SnapshotDelay>
        <Sensitivity><--xs:interger--></Sensitivity>
    </ModeOptimal>
    <ModeCustom>
        <SnapshotCount><--xs:interger,1~3--></SnapshotCount>
        <MaxSnapshotCount><--xs:interger,1~3--></MaxSnapshotCount>
        <PicQualityThreshold><--xs:interger,0-100--></PicQualityThreshold>
        <Sensitivity><--xs:interger--></Sensitivity>
        <ObliqueAngle>
            <MaxValue><--xs:interger,0-180 --><MaxValue>
            <MinValue><--xs:interger,0-180 --><MinValue>
        </ObliqueAngle>
        <PitchAngle>
            <MaxValue><--xs:interger,0-180, the unit is angle--><MaxValue>
            <MinValue><--xs:interger,0-180, the unit is angle --><MinValue>
        </PitchAngle>
        <SideAngle>
            <MaxValue><--xs:interger,0-180, the unit is angle --><MaxValue>
            <MinValue><--xs:interger,0-180, the unit is angle --><MinValue>
        </SideAngle>
        <FuzzyDegree>
            <MaxValue><--xs:interger,0-100 --><MaxValue>
            <MinValue><--xs:interger,0-100 --><MinValue>
        </FuzzyDegree>
    </ModeCustom>
    <ModePass>
        <SnapshotInterval><--xs:interger,the unit is ms, 200-5000--></SnapshotInterval>
        <Sensitivity><--xs:interger--></Sensitivity>
    </ModePass>
</FaceConfig>
```
